improving the treatment and prevention and reducing the mortality from breast cancer.
the development, evaluation, and dissemination of new and effective approaches to the prevention, early detection, and treatment of breast and colorectral cancer.
the development and evaluation of innovative therapies to treat and prevent breast and colorectal cancers.

the NSABP's research has been responsible for the most dramatic improvement in the treatment and prevention in breast and colorectal cancers over the past 5 decades.
the NSABP is the most productive and effective cancer research cooperative trials group ever to be established in the world.
the NSABP's 50 years of clinical research has had an enormous impact on the treatment of breast and colorectum cancers and on the prevention of breast and colon cancers.

the NSABP, through its trials, has demonstrated that breast cancer can be cured by surgery and that the addition of radiation to surgery improves the cure rate.
